resources.name: AllocationJournal
resources.doc:
Unique ordinal seals one pool state transition. Raw rows are NOT authority
until the bounded consuming interpreter validates the complete chain.

resources.name: AllocationReservation
resources.doc: Inert candidate: only a valid committed pool journal authorizes ownership.

resources.name: AssetConfiguration
resources.doc: Explicit domain configuration snapshot hook; does not implement a configuration engine.

resources.name: AttestationSubject
resources.doc: Typed domain links bind this subject, never a targetType/targetId pair.

resources.name: DemandAllocation
resources.doc: Planning references are not proof of reserved capacity or execution.

resources.name: DemandGroup
resources.doc: Membership groups compatible demand; it never creates extra fulfillable quantity.

resources.name: FulfillmentEnd
resources.doc: Terminal business observation wins over any late execution-start report.

resources.name: FulfillmentExecutor
resources.doc: Executor-specific handle; domain satellites own human/agent/equipment details.

resources.name: FulfillmentTaskLink
resources.doc: Kernel task address, not an application EntityRef or business request payload.

enums.name: VisibilityKind
enums.doc: Visibility semantics attach to admitted movements; they never change stock themselves.

resources.name: InventoryMovement
resources.doc: One stock-item history serializes all positions and stock claims.

resources.name: MetricBreachEffect
resources.doc: A response is separate from the observation and never silently executes work.

resources.name: MetricBreachEvent
resources.doc: Occurrence consumed through Measurements.breach, which verifies the threshold.

resources.name: MetricObservation
resources.doc: Derived candidates are interpreted and verified, not trusted because CRUD succeeded.

resources.name: Place
resources.doc: Identity survives containment moves. Kernel audit preserves committed changes.

resources.name: PlaceAddressRevision
resources.doc: Address is an optional typed extension, never the identity of a Place.

resources.name: PlaceTimezoneRevision
resources.doc: A separate history lets virtual or addressless places have a timezone.

resources.name: PartyResourceRelation
resources.doc: Staging is not establishment. Only a validated RelationCommit admits a candidate.

resources.name: RelationCommit
resources.doc: One atomic durable fact publishes current and ends prior at the same knowledge time.

resources.name: RelationKind
resources.doc: Pinned domain vocabulary: ownership, control, custody, operator, host, payer, etc.

resources.name: RelationSource
resources.doc: Domain events, agreements or attestations can attach typed satellites to this source.

resources.name: ResourceSubject
resources.doc: A domain-owned resource satellite points to this identity, never a polymorphic target.

resources.name: UsageCorrection
resources.doc: A staged replacement contributes only after this terminal link is committed.

resources.name: UsageDimension
resources.doc: Domain vocabulary fixes one exact unit per dimension; conversion is explicit above.

classification.business: declared domain errors: served, counted separately
classification.counting: one event per logical operation; retries are attempts on the same event, never new events
